requirements.title: Scheduled at Two Hertz
requirements.description: The telem_app shall be scheduled to execute at 2 Hz on the static TDM scheduler.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-019: 2 Hz downlink cadence balances LoRa link budget against ground observability.

requirements.title: Subscribe to Telemetry Source Messages
requirements.description: The telem_app shall subscribe to GPS, baro, navigation, flight phase, and sensor health messages on the software bus.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-020: packet content requires composition from these sources via the bus.

requirements.title: Compose Packet via telem_lib
requirements.description: The telem_app shall invoke telem_lib to compose a telemetry packet from subscribed bus messages.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-020: app delegates packet composition logic to its controller library per MVC.

requirements.title: Embed Sensor Health Bitmap
requirements.description: The telem_app shall include the latest published sensor health bitmap in each transmitted packet.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-031: per-sensor health observability is required in every telemetry packet.

requirements.title: Transmit via lora_lib
requirements.description: The telem_app shall hand each composed packet to lora_lib for transmission over the LoRa radio.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-003: live telemetry downlink requires app to invoke radio library.

requirements.title: Continuous Operation From Power-On
requirements.description: The telem app shall execute every cycle from power-on until external power is removed.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-021: continuous telemetry coverage from power-on until external power removed.

requirements.title: Continue After Transmission Failure
requirements.description: The telem_app shall continue executing subsequent cycles after a transmission failure without halting or backing off.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-036: radio loss must not impair operation; no backoff per PM brief.

requirements.title: Publish Radio Health Status
requirements.description: The telem_app shall publish a radio health status indicating success or failure of the most recent transmission.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-061: radio transmission failures are surfaced via the published health state.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The telem app shall produce identical published telemetry on POSIX and Pico2 builds for identical bus inputs.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-043: POSIX build must be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build for Trick simulation.

requirements.title: Post-Landing Recovery Beacon
requirements.description: The telem app shall continue transmitting telemetry indefinitely after landing until external power is removed.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-048: post-landing recovery beaconing supports locating the rocket after landing.

requirements.title: Deterministic Telemetry Output
requirements.description: The telem app shall produce identical published telemetry given identical bus inputs.
requirements.rationale: Derived from SW-REQ-SYS-044: determinism required for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
